rows.summary: [1 sample] The story is about Iris, who rescored the final round of a competition on Sunday night and won the award on Monday. The award was for Aldana Workshop, which Iris had grown up sharing a house and a bunk-bed room with. Iris had started a monthly retainer from a consultancy with no address the week the shortlist was posted, and she filed its invoice under miscellaneous and started the kettle.
